description: Vectorised inscribed-sphere tunnel radius profile along and beyond the glucan paths in AcsD and BcsA
code:
exec(open("_lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
AA=set('ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL MSE'.split())

def mk_C(xyz,rad):
    tr=cKDTree(xyz)
    def C(pts):
        d,i=tr.query(pts,k=16,workers=-1)
        return (d-rad[i]).min(1)
    return C

def profile(C, pts, half=3.0, step=0.3, iters=3):
    best=pts.copy()
    for _ in range(iters):
        g=np.arange(-half,half+1e-9,step)
        off=np.stack(np.meshgrid(g,g,g,indexing="ij"),-1).reshape(-1,3)
        cand=(best[:,None,:]+off[None,:,:]).reshape(-1,3)
        v=C(cand).reshape(len(pts),-1)
        k=v.argmax(1); best=cand.reshape(len(pts),-1,3)[np.arange(len(pts)),k]
        half/=3.; step/=3.
    return C(best), best

B=framed("3A8E"); P8=B[B.resn!="BGC"]
Cacs=mk_C(P8[["px","py","pz"]].values, P8.el.map(VDW).fillna(1.7).values)
lig=B[(B.resn=="BGC")&(B.uchain=="F_0")][["px","py","pz"]].values
cen=lig.mean(0); r0=float(np.hypot(*cen[:2])); pitch=43.6; th0=np.arctan2(cen[1],cen[0])
ss=np.arange(-30,30.01,1.0)
hel=np.column_stack([r0*np.cos(th0+ss*np.sin(np.radians(pitch))/r0),
                     r0*np.sin(th0+ss*np.sin(np.radians(pitch))/r0),
                     cen[2]+ss*np.cos(np.radians(pitch))])
Racs,Pacs=profile(Cacs,hel)
acs=pd.DataFrame(dict(s=ss,R=np.round(Racs,2)))

df=parse_pdb("./4HG6.pdb"); pr=df[df.resn.isin(AA)]
Cbcs=mk_C(pr[["x","y","z"]].values, pr.el.map(VDW).fillna(1.7).values)
gl=df[(df.resn=="BGC")&(df.chain=="C")]
rc=gl.groupby("resi")[["x","y","z"]].mean().sort_index().values
d=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(rc,axis=0),axis=1))]
tt=np.arange(0,d[-1],1.0)
path=np.column_stack([np.interp(tt,d,rc[:,k]) for k in range(3)])
Rb,_=profile(Cbcs,path)
bcs=pd.DataFrame(dict(s=tt-d[-1]/2,R=np.round(Rb,2)))

HL=11.2
occ=acs[acs.s.abs()<=HL]; bey=acs[acs.s.abs()>HL+2]
print("=== inscribed-sphere tunnel radius along the glucan path (glucan deleted) ===")
print(f"AcsD, span occupied by the cellopentaose (|s|<={HL} A): R {occ.R.min():.2f}-{occ.R.max():.2f} A, mean {occ.R.mean():.2f}")
print(f"AcsD, beyond the ligand ends (|s|>{HL+2} A):            R {bey.R.min():.2f}-{bey.R.max():.2f} A, mean {bey.R.mean():.2f}")
print(f"BcsA, whole glucan path:                                R {bcs.R.min():.2f}-{bcs.R.max():.2f} A, mean {bcs.R.mean():.2f}")
print(f"BcsA, transmembrane stretch |s|<10 A:                   R {bcs[bcs.s.abs()<10].R.min():.2f}-{bcs[bcs.s.abs()<10].R.max():.2f} A")
print("\nAcsD profile (s, R):"); print(acs[::3].to_string(index=False))
pd.concat([acs.assign(case='AcsD_helix_3A8E'),bcs.assign(case='BcsA_glucan_4HG6')]).to_csv("tunnel_radius_profiles.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.8,4.3))
ax.plot(acs.s,acs.R,"-o",ms=2.5,color="#dd6b20",label="AcsD 3A8E, helical path through the cellopentaose site")
ax.plot(bcs.s,bcs.R,"-o",ms=2.5,color="#2b6cb0",label="BcsA 4HG6, path of the nascent glucan")
ax.axvspan(-HL,HL,color="#dd6b20",alpha=.12)
ax.axhline(4.1,color="k",ls=":",lw=1)
ax.text(-29.5,4.25,"radius needed to clear a glucan chain (~4.1 A)",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("position along the path, 0 = centre of the bound glucan (A)")
ax.set_ylabel("largest inscribed sphere radius, glucan deleted (A)")
ax.set_title("Does a conduit continue beyond the bound glucan?")
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="upper right"); ax.grid(alpha=.3); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
